_doc: test-e2e cases for this block (same shape as a test-e2e/cases.json "blocks" entry, plus "conflicts"). The defaults case always runs; registryDependencies (crypto-utils, cf-email-sender) are installed first from blocks/. Each case installs into a fresh copy of templates/hono-d1 and runs verify.commands. A "conflicts" entry first writes the "setup" files into the project, expects the install (dry run) to exit 1 with the listed conflicts, then installs with "resolve.params" and expects verify to pass.
